UPDATE agent_runs SET updated_at=?, last_progress_at=CASE WHEN (agent_runs.storage_format = ?) THEN ? ELSE agent_runs.last_progress_at END WHERE agent_runs.id = ? AND agent_runs.claim_epoch = ?

INSERT INTO react_traces (id, agent_run_id, role, content, trace_kind, content_digest, order_index, meta, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

UPDATE agent_runs SET updated_at=?, loop_state=?, reclaim_attempts=CASE WHEN (NOT (EXISTS (SELECT react_traces.id FROM react_traces WHERE react_traces.id = ?))) THEN ? ELSE agent_runs.reclaim_attempts END, last_progress_at=CASE WHEN (agent_runs.storage_format = ?) THEN ? ELSE agent_runs.last_progress_at END WHERE agent_runs.id = ? AND agent_runs.claim_epoch = ?

INSERT INTO react_traces (id, agent_run_id, role, content, trace_kind, content_digest, order_index, meta, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
